title: Scenario description
description: Optional names and description used to convert one logged observations/actions pair into a scenario. Every field is optional; the converter fills gaps and checks the result.

input_name.description: Stem of the logged pair, such as messy_cone_test. Not a filename.

output_name.description: Scenario filename stem. The file is this value with .json appended.

name.description: Display name stored in the scenario.

description.description: Description stored in the scenario. An empty string means no description.
